name: player_update_ai_mode2_move_and_turn_toward_offset_target
description: AINet::UpdateAiMode2MoveAndTurnTowardOffsetTarget rotates the target-to-player flat direction by 15 degrees, scales it by AINet pursuitParam0, then steers and throttles toward that offset target.
known_limits: Functional target covers direct-ahead, side-clamp, behind-turn-sign, and nonzero rotated-offset steering paths. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent AI mode-2 player cluster.
